name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ADM-10 'Overseer'
description:
The ADM-10 Overseer is Arcturus' corporate security DMR, designed to provide precision overwatch for corporate facility perimeters and urban security operations. The rifle fires 6.5mm caseless from a 20-round magazine and features an integrated smart-scope that combines optical magnification with BCI-enhanced target identification, distance ranging, wind measurement, and ballistic calculation in a single neural overlay.

The Overseer's smart-scope connects to Arcturus' corporate surveillance network, overlaying real-time intelligence on the marksman's field of view. Security camera feeds, personnel tracking data, threat assessments, and engagement authorization status are all displayed in the BCI neural overlay. The marksman sees not just their target but the entire tactical picture, making informed engagement decisions without relying on radio communication.

At Φ14,000, the Overseer is priced for institutional procurement. Arcturus deploys them at corporate campuses, industrial facilities, and anywhere their interests require precision overwatch. The weapon's surveillance integration makes it as much an intelligence tool as a weapon — the marksman provides eyes and analysis as well as lethal capability. In Arcturus doctrine, the designated marksman is the team's most information-rich position.
specifications:
caliber: 6.5mm caseless
effective_range: 800m
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 20 rounds
weight: 4.5 kg
tactical_use: The Overseer provides precision fire support integrated with real-time intelligence. The marksman's surveillance overlay allows threat identification and engagement authorization without radio communication, reducing response time and preventing miscommunication errors. The smart-scope's automated ballistic calculation delivers firing solutions for any range and wind condition within the weapon's envelope, allowing rapid engagement of multiple targets at varying distances.
cultural_context: The Overseer embodies Arcturus' approach to security: total information dominance expressed through precision violence. The weapon's integration with corporate surveillance networks means the marksman is watching everything the cameras see, knowing everything the database knows about every person in their field of fire. For corporate personnel, the Overseer's presence is reassuring. For everyone else, it is the knowledge that somewhere above, someone who knows your name is looking at you through a scope.
story_hooks: An Overseer marksman's surveillance overlay was compromised, displaying falsified intelligence that led them to engage an undercover operative who was actually on the same side.

The Overseer's surveillance feed has been recording and storing everything the marksman sees for years. This accumulated visual intelligence — including private moments witnessed from overwatch positions — has been discovered by a data thief.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modular precision rifle with a distinctly corporate aesthetic. The integrated smart-scope dominates the upper receiver as a pronounced hexagonal turret, bristling with sensor arrays and optical elements. The profile is angular and purposeful—clean lines interrupted by purposeful technical details. The weapon reads as intelligent surveillance hardware first, lethal tool second.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 1,120mm. Barrel length: 560mm. Smart-scope turret: 85mm long, 65mm diameter. Magazine well positioned for rapid reloads.
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 4.5kg, with the mass distributed toward the scope turret. Feels slightly nose-heavy when shouldered, demanding steady cheek-weld technique. The balance point suggests hours of precision work rather than spray-and-pray engagement.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade carbon composite chassis with reinforced polymer furniture. Smart-scope housing is brushed titanium alloy with embedded sensor ports. Barrel is chrome-molybdenum steel.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray on the composite surfaces with a subtle brushed sheen on titanium components. The finish is deliberately subdued—corporate discretion rather than tactical flash. Minor wear patterns on the charging handle and magazine well suggest field deployment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte gunmetal-gray primary with brushed titanium accents on the scope turret. Subdued Arcturus blue accent striping along the receiver rail (corporate branding, minimal). Black rubberized grip and foregrip.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured thermoplastic grip with subtle finger grooves, designed for prolonged shooting sessions. Cool to the touch, non-slip even when wet. Foregrip is wrapped in rubberized polymer with fine crosshatch pattern for weapon-mounted sensor cable management.
distinctive_features: Hexagonal smart-scope turret with visible sensor clusters and LED indicator ring (currently dark)
Thin optical window showing multi-layered lens assembly
Recessed BCI neural link port on the left side of the scope housing (protected by magnetic dust cap bearing Arcturus logo)
Three heat vents positioned along the receiver rail for thermal management during sustained operation
Integrated cable management channels running along the rail system
Soft-touch polymer coating on all user contact surfaces
Subtle Arcturus 'A' logo etched into the magazine well
Ambidextrous safety lever with detent click mechanism
Quick-detach magazine release with indexed rotational design
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo and 'ADM-10 OVERSEER' designation etched into the dust cover in corporate sans-serif font. Serial number engraved on the lower receiver. 'BLACKWOOD COMMERCIAL GROUP' stamped discreetly on the barrel collar in 4-point font. Compliance markings and caliber designation marked on the magazine.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained and field-ready. This is a corporate asset with regular service cycles. You'd see minor scuff marks on the composite surfaces but no pitting or corrosion. The smart-scope shows signs of active use—slight dust accumulation in the sensor ring, but lens surfaces are clean. This weapon is regularly calibrated and updated.
